subject: Next steps: booking tech deep-dive and evaluation playbook
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@acumenhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + request: availability to schedule tech deep-dive / eval kickoff

Hi Olivia — thanks again for taking time today. Helpful to learn more about Acumen Health's priorities for Q4 (reducing triage latency for clinician notes, and surfacing more accurate summaries for referral letters).

Recap / proposed next steps:
- Tech deep-dive (60m): connect your engineering/observability folks so Ben can validate integration points (S3 ingestion, auth, and tokenization).
- Evaluation kickoff (90m): align success criteria, trial plan, and initial prompt set for the first two use cases.
- Mutual action plan: we’ll provide a one-page eval playbook and a suggested prompt pack; you’ll share a small sample dataset and a point of contact for access.

Can you share windows that work for the tech deep-dive this or next week? I’ve attached a short eval playbook draft and an .ics with a couple proposed slots. If it helps, here are times (PT):
- Thu Oct 8: 10:00–11:00 or 15:00–16:00
- Tue Oct 13: 09:00–10:00 or 13:00–14:30 (longer if we kick off the eval in the same meeting)

If you prefer, we can split into two meetings (SE + kickoff) — whatever minimizes your team's prep.

Attaching: Redwood_Eval_Playbook_v1.pdf (playbook draft), proposed-kickoff-times.ics

Thanks — looking forward to locking a slot.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
 diego@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0189

From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@acumenhealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <pilot@acumenhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + request: availability to schedule tech deep-dive / eval kickoff

Diego — thanks for the clear recap. Our CTO is out this week but Samir (pilot coordinator) and I can do a session. The suggested playbook looks good at a glance. Two quick asks before we lock:

1) Success criteria: can you include the short-form success metrics you usually track for a 30-day eval? We want to line those up with our clinical metrics team.
2) Data access: Samir will confirm whether we can share a representative sample of notes this week or if we need an anonymization step first.

Availability (ET):
- Fri Oct 9: 11:00–12:00 ET (8:00–9:00 PT)
- Tue Oct 13: 14:00–15:30 ET (11:00–12:30 PT) — pref if the longer slot can cover the kickoff agenda

Either works for us; please propose the final meeting link and attendee list.

Thanks,
Olivia Barnes
Head of Clinical Ops, Acumen Health
olivia@acumenhealth.com | +1 (617) 555-3122

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@acumenhealth.com>, Samir Patel <pilot@acumenhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 08 Oct 2026 08:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + request: availability to schedule tech deep-dive / eval kickoff

Great — appreciate the quick reply. I added the short success metrics below (also in the attached playbook):
- Latency: average token-to-token latency for streaming summaries under 200ms per token at 8k context
- Throughput: sustained 2 concurrent sessions with 95th percentile latency SLA
- Quality: summary F1 > 0.8 on your internal test set (we'll use your sample notes)
- False positive rate on redaction checks < 1%

Proposal: lock Tue Oct 13, 11:00–12:30 PT (14:00–15:30 ET) as the kickoff (we can use the first 60m for the tech deep-dive and the last 30m to align success criteria and next steps).

Marissa and Ben — can you both join? Ben, we'd like you to walk through integration checklist (S3 presets, auth flows, and ingestion rate assumptions). Marissa, please prepare the eval charter slide (objectives, measures, timelines). Karthik — feel free to bring any sample prompts or quantization notes that typically help reduce infra cost during a trial.

Olivia / Samir — if that time works I'll send a calendar invite with the agenda and a short prework checklist.

Attachments: Redwood_Eval_Playbook_v1.pdf (updated with metrics), proposed-kickoff-times.ics

Thanks — Diego

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 14:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + request: availability to schedule tech deep-dive / eval kickoff

Confirmed for Tue Oct 13, 11:00–12:30 PT — I've blocked my calendar and will draft the agenda now.

Draft agenda (we can tighten):
- 11:00–11:05 | Intros and outcomes (Diego)
- 11:05–11:35 | Tech deep-dive (Ben) — integration, auth, sample payloads
- 11:35–12:00 | Eval charter & success metrics (Marissa + Olivia)
- 12:00–12:20 | Prompt set & initial eval plan (Karthik)
- 12:20–12:30 | Next steps, owner assignments, timelines

I’ll attach a one-page prework checklist to the invite (sample dataset spec, contact for S3 access, and a short security Q&A). Diego — can you confirm who will own the DocuSign/order path if procurement needs an expedited quote?

Thanks team — excited to get this moving.

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0222
